item.title: Hudson Valley HIEroes strives to raise awareness of brain injury in newborns
item.description: MOUNT MARION, N.Y. — When Katelyn Farcher’s daughter suffered a brain injury at birth from a lack of oxygen, Farcher made it her mission to make sure families in the same situation had a community to fall back on.
